instruction.text: Find the shadow created by the ice cream cone.

feedback.end: A shadow is created when an opaque object blocks light from a light source. The shadow is the same shape as the object.

atoms.b: Shadows don’t change shape, but can they change size?
If an opaque object moves closer to a light source, ((++more less)) light will be blocked. This means the shadow will become ((++bigger smaller)).
If an opaque object moves further away from a light source, ((more ++less)) light will be blocked. This means the shadow will become ((bigger ++smaller)).

instruction.text: Select the object that will make the larger shadow.

feedback.correct: The closer the object is to the light source, the larger the shadow will be.

instruction.text: Select the object that will make the smaller shadow.

feedback.correct: The further away the object is from the light source, the smaller the shadow will be.
